## Review checklist
- [ ] Focused changes, within one app where possible
- [ ] Documentation and the affected apps' CHANGELOG.md updated where needed
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data (including in web/mobile/desktop configuration and plan output)
- [ ] Required human/specialist review identified (`review:*` labels)
